ci_support_linux_64_python3.10.____cpyth:
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '14'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma9
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.10.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
name: pyglm
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pyglm
  version: "2.8.3"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/pyglm-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 161781ea4d1267f796b645f85ebff53aeb8ee4f13b4e993c04d64c96d286e534

build:
  number: 2
  script: python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - pip
        - python
        - setuptools
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - glm
  - script:
      - pip check
      - python run_test.py
    files:
      recipe:
        - run_test.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/Zuzu-Typ/PyGLM
  repository: https://github.com/Zuzu-Typ/PyGLM
  summary: OpenGL Mathematics library for Python
  license: Zlib
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jeongseok-meta
